templates.label: Fall-Arrest Harness
templates.slotUse: worn over clothing or light armor
templates.activation: Immediate action when the wearer begins falling; reset requires 1 minute.
effects: Gain +4 circumstance on checks to catch a ledge, rope, rail, or safety line and reduce effective falling distance by 30 feet.
A tethered wearer may arrest a fall after 20 feet and hang safely until the anchor fails or the line is cut.
Once per encounter, convert uncontrolled falling into a controlled 60-foot-per-round descent for 3 rounds.
templates.maintenance: Inspect anchors, stitching, and line after every arrested fall.
templates.restrictions: Requires a secure anchor, deployed line, or open space for its slowing mechanism.

templates.label: Expedition Weather Suit
templates.slotUse: body garment; may be worn beneath medium armor
templates.activation: Passive while worn and properly sealed.
effects: Gain +2 circumstance on Fortitude saves against ordinary heat, cold, wind, and exposure.
Ignore the first 2 points of nonlethal environmental damage each hour and gain +2 Survival against severe weather.
Provide cold resistance 5 or fire resistance 5 against environmental sources only; choose during construction.
templates.maintenance: Dry, clean, and reseal the garment after severe weather or immersion.
templates.restrictions: Does not protect against magical weather, direct energy attacks, or lack of breathable air unless upgraded.

templates.label: Field Repair Rig
templates.activation: Used as part of a repair attempt.
effects: Gain +2 circumstance on Craft checks to diagnose and repair mechanical devices, constructs, and vehicle components.
Once per day complete 1 hour of emergency repair in 10 minutes, but the repaired device gains one temporary minor flaw until properly serviced.
Carry calibrated replacement parts allowing one disabled routine device to operate for 10 minutes after a DC 15 Craft check.
templates.maintenance: Replace consumed fasteners, seals, wire, and calibration stock after each emergency repair.
templates.restrictions: Does not replace rare components or repair a destroyed item.

templates.label: Grapnel Launcher
templates.activation: Standard action to fire; full-round action to rewind manually.
effects: Launch a grapnel to 60 feet as a ranged touch attack against a specific anchor point; the line supports 500 pounds.
Grant the user a 20-foot climb speed along the deployed line for up to 5 rounds after successful anchoring.
A struck Medium or smaller creature must pass Reflex DC 15 or become tethered and unable to move farther from the launcher until it escapes or cuts the line.
templates.maintenance: Inspect cable and rewind assembly after every ten launches.
templates.restrictions: The grapnel cannot penetrate heavy armor, stone, or reinforced hull plating without a specialized head.

templates.label: Emergency Signal Beacon
templates.activation: Standard action; signal lasts 10 minutes per charge.
effects: Produce a bright visible signal detectable at 1 mile, or 5 miles in clear open sky.
Broadcast an audible or coded pulse that grants +4 circumstance on Search or Spot checks made specifically to locate the beacon.
Mark a location with a colored smoke column for 10 minutes; ordinary wind may bend but does not immediately disperse it.
templates.maintenance: Replace the charge after use and keep the signal aperture clean.
templates.restrictions: Weather, terrain, magical darkness, and enemy jamming can reduce detection range.

templates.label: Field Water Purifier
templates.activation: Ten minutes of operation per batch.
effects: Purify up to 10 gallons of ordinary contaminated water per day and grant +4 on checks to detect remaining contamination.
Remove mundane disease organisms and common poisons from 5 gallons per charge; magical contamination is unaffected.
Produce drinking water for ten Medium creatures per day from rain, fog, or damp plant matter when operated in a humid environment.
templates.maintenance: Replace filters or catalyst salts after every 50 gallons.
templates.restrictions: Cannot desalinate concentrated brine or remove curses without an advanced upgrade.

templates.label: Surveyor Optic
templates.activation: Move action to focus; benefit lasts while observing the same area.
effects: Gain +2 competence on Search and Spot checks made at distances greater than 30 feet.
Gain +2 competence on Knowledge (geography) and Profession (navigator) checks to measure distance, drift, or relative altitude.
Once per hour, measure the approximate range and size category of a visible object or creature within 2 miles.
templates.maintenance: Clean and recalibrate the lenses after impact or major temperature change.
templates.restrictions: Fog, darkness, concealment, and solid barriers apply normally.

templates.label: Portable Communication Set
templates.testSkill: Use Magic Device or Profession (signal officer)
templates.activation: Standard action to establish a channel; speaking is otherwise free.
effects: Transmit intelligible speech between paired sets within 1 mile in open sky and 300 feet through ordinary structures.
Transmit coded pulses within 5 miles; decoding without the paired key requires Decipher Script DC 20.
Create a short-range crew network linking up to six sets within 1,000 feet for 1 hour per charge.
templates.maintenance: Retune paired crystals after every month or after exposure to dispelling magic.
templates.restrictions: Strong storms, dense stone, deliberate jamming, and planar boundaries block or reduce range.

templates.label: Portable Ward Projector
templates.activation: Standard action; operates for 5 rounds per charge.
effects: Create a 10-foot-radius field granting +2 deflection AC against ranged attacks.
Grant creatures in a 10-foot radius energy resistance 5 against one chosen energy type.
Grant +2 resistance on saves against wind, forced movement, and magical weather within a 10-foot radius.
templates.maintenance: Inspect the ward lattice and recharge after every three activations.
templates.restrictions: Only one projected ward from the same device may operate at a time.

templates.label: Alchemical Disperser
templates.activation: Standard action; consumes one prepared canister.
effects: Project a 15-foot cone dealing 2d6 fire, cold, or acid damage; Reflex DC 15 halves.
Fill a 10-foot-radius area within 30 feet with obscuring smoke for 5 rounds.
Coat a 10-foot square with adhesive foam; creatures entering must pass Reflex DC 15 or become entangled until they escape with Strength or Escape Artist DC 15.
templates.maintenance: Flush valves and replace seals after every use.
templates.restrictions: Ammunition is hazardous cargo and may be restricted by port law.

templates.label: Medical Stabilizer
templates.activation: Full-round action adjacent to the patient.
effects: Grant +4 circumstance on Heal checks to stabilize dying creatures and treat poison or disease.
Once per day restore 1d8+3 hit points to a living creature after 1 minute of treatment.
Suspend one poison or disease's secondary effects for 1 hour after a successful Heal check against its save DC.
templates.maintenance: Replace sterile supplies after every treatment and recalibrate needles weekly.
templates.restrictions: Cannot restore life, regrow limbs, or remove magical disease without an appropriate advanced component.

templates.label: Salvage Scanner
templates.activation: One minute scan of an object, wreck section, or 10-foot cube.
effects: Gain +4 circumstance on Appraise checks to identify valuable components and reusable materials.
Detect active power, heat, or magical conduction through up to 1 foot of ordinary material within 30 feet.
Identify a damaged object's lowest-hardness access point and grant +2 insight on the next repair or Disable Device check involving it.
templates.maintenance: Recalibrate against a known sample after every ten scans.
templates.restrictions: Lead, dense warding, active interference, and unknown planar materials can block or falsify readings.

templates.label: Arc Cutter
templates.activation: Standard action against an object or melee attack against a creature.
effects: Ignore 5 points of hardness when cutting unattended objects and deal 2d6 fire damage to the target object.
Make a melee touch attack dealing 1d8 fire and electricity damage; the cutter is not treated as a normal martial weapon for iterative attacks.
Cut through one inch of ordinary metal or three inches of wood after 1 minute of uninterrupted work.
templates.maintenance: Clean the cutting head and inspect insulation after every ten rounds of use.
templates.restrictions: Overheats after five consecutive rounds and must cool for five rounds.

templates.label: Balanced Weapon Fitting
templates.activation: Passive after installation and one hour of familiarization.
effects: The weapon becomes masterwork and grants +1 enhancement bonus on attack rolls, but not damage rolls.
Reduce one reload action from full-round to standard or standard to move; cannot reduce below move action.
Grant +2 circumstance on disarm checks made with the fitted weapon and +2 to resist being disarmed.
templates.maintenance: Rebalance after the weapon is damaged, reforged, or fitted with another major upgrade.
templates.restrictions: A weapon can benefit from only one balance fitting at a time.

templates.label: Elemental Weapon Capacitor
templates.activation: Swift action; three activations per day, each lasting 5 rounds.
effects: The weapon deals +1d6 fire damage while active.
The weapon deals +1d6 electricity damage while active.
The weapon deals +1d6 cold damage while active.
templates.maintenance: Recharge and inspect the capacitor after every day in which it is used.
templates.restrictions: Does not stack with another elemental capacitor on the same weapon.

templates.label: Impact-Dampening Armor Liner
templates.slotUse: installed beneath one suit of armor
templates.activation: Passive while the armor is worn.
effects: Reduce falling and collision damage by 1 point per die, minimum 1 point per die.
Gain damage reduction 1/— against nonlethal bludgeoning damage and ordinary turbulence.
Gain +2 circumstance on Fortitude saves against stunning or dazing caused by impacts.
templates.maintenance: Replace compressed pads after any fall dealing more than 20 damage.
templates.restrictions: Increases the armor's weight by the listed amount and does not stack with another dampening liner.

templates.label: Environmental Armor Seal
templates.slotUse: installed on one suit of medium or heavy armor
templates.activation: Move action to seal; air supply lasts 10 minutes.
effects: Gain +4 circumstance on saves against smoke, toxic dust, and airborne disease while sealed.
Provide fire resistance 5 and cold resistance 5 against environmental exposure while sealed.
Maintain breathable air for 10 minutes and protect against ordinary low-pressure conditions.
templates.maintenance: Replace seals and air cartridge after every activation.
templates.restrictions: While sealed, Listen checks take -4 and strenuous activity halves remaining air duration.

templates.label: Tracker Beacon
templates.activation: Standard action to arm; operates for 24 hours per charge.
effects: A paired receiver gains +4 circumstance on checks to track the beacon within 5 miles in open sky.
Transmit a coded directional pulse once per minute within 10 miles when connected to a vessel core.
Record the beacon's approximate route for 24 hours, downloadable with 10 minutes of work.
templates.maintenance: Retune paired beacon and receiver after every month.
templates.restrictions: Dense stone, magical interference, and deliberate shielding reduce or block the signal.

templates.label: Portable Shelter Frame
templates.slotUse: packed load; deploys into a 10-foot camp
templates.activation: Ten minutes to deploy or pack.
effects: Provide secure weatherproof shelter for four Medium creatures and grant +2 on saves against ordinary exposure.
Anchor to a ship deck or island surface and grant +4 circumstance on checks to resist severe wind.
Collect up to 5 gallons of rainwater per hour of moderate rain.
templates.maintenance: Dry fabric, inspect anchors, and replace damaged struts after severe weather.
templates.restrictions: Cannot be safely deployed during active combat without cover or assistance.
